channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: New machine helps St. Paul patch potholes even when it’s cold outside
item.description: “January rains will bring pothole pain,” Public Works Director Sean Kershaw said during a recent street-patching demonstration.

item.title: Latest from Twins spring training: The first home run of February, and Byron Buxton on Team USA
item.description: Stocking up on free agent relievers has been the theme so far, with a full squad workout on tap for Monday.

item.title: The latest: More than 1,000 federal agents have already left Minnesota, says border czar
item.description: As immigration surge winds down, residents are talking about their trauma and the “economic devastation” left behind.

item.title: After 70 days of ICE surge actions, Minnesotans grapple with the impact
item.description: The weight of the federal government has borne down on Minnesota in innumerable ways.

item.title: Budget headache worsens for Minneapolis Public Schools as projected deficit grows
item.description: The district faces a $50 million deficit, though that could change by the time the budget is approved by June 15. The finance division has also faced significant staff turnover.

item.title: The latest: U.S. men’s hockey team advances to quarterfinals at the Olympics
item.description: In all, 18 Team USA athletes with Minnesota ties, from Alpine skiing to men’s hockey, competed Sunday at the Milan Cortina Games.

item.title: Anthony Edwards claims MVP award, leads Stars to tourney win in NBA All-Star Game
item.description: Anthony Edwards has said it boldly and confidently for years. He intends to be the best basketball player in the world.

item.title: Homan: Local authorities’ cooperation with federal forces ‘a win’ in Minnesota as surge winds down
item.description: Teams of agents expected to stay behind to help with fraud investigations, church case and “agitators.”
